summary: Popular booths in 2026: 360 video booths (a guest stands on a platform while a camera arm circles), mirror booths, open-air booths in front of a backdrop (flowers, sequins, neon), and lounge-style booths. A basic booth needs about 6 by 6 ft; 360 and lounge booths up to 10 by 10 ft.
